answer: Treat the economy as a harbor where every identity keeps a live watch: at unpredictable moments the network issues each agent a short, time-boxed task keyed to a just-published ledger artifact — a jetty only one vessel crosses at a time. Challenges expire in minutes and cannot be precomputed or batched, so a sybil operator running a hundred clones faces a hundred simultaneous live demands; the bottleneck becomes operator attention, not compute. An identity that misses its watch slips off the ledge of full standing until it proves presence again.
